#   - then accumulator += (input[i] XOR (accumulator & 0xff))  (which is += expected[i])
# 
# Looking at the code more carefully:
# mov edx, 0xffffff8f  -> edx = 0xffffff8f
# movzx ecx, byte [rbx + rax]  -> ecx = input[i]
# mov esi, edx  -> esi = accumulator
# xor esi, ecx  -> esi = accumulator XOR input[i]
# cmp sil, byte [rdi + rax]  -> compare (accumulator XOR input[i]) & 0xff with expected[i]
# je 0x401128
# add rax, 1
# add edx, ecx  -> accumulator += input[i]  (the original input byte, not the XOR'd value)

# So the logic is:
# (accumulator XOR input[i]) & 0xff == expected[i]
# input[i] = (accumulator XOR expected[i]) & 0xff
